GAP Broadcaster Exported Types

group GAP_Broadcaster_Exported_Types

Enums

enum T_LE_ADV_PARAM_TYPE

LE advertising parameter types.

Values:

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_LOCAL_ADDR_TYPE

The type of local address being used in the advertising packets. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_LOCAL_ADDR_TYPE. Default value is GAP_LOCAL_ADDR_LE_PUBLIC.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_DATA

Advertisement Data. Read/Write. Maximum size is 31 octets GAP_MAX_ADV_LEN. Default value is '02:01:05', which means that it is a Limited Discoverable Advertisement.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_SCAN_RSP_DATA

Scan Response Data. Read/Write. Maximum size is 31 octets GAP_MAX_ADV_LEN. Default value is all zero.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_EVENT_TYPE

Advertisement Type. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_ADTYPE. Default value is GAP_ADTYPE_ADV_IND.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_DIRECT_ADDR_TYPE

Direct Advertisement Address Type. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE. Default value is GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_LE_PUBLIC.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_DIRECT_ADDR

Direct Advertisement Address. Read/Write. Size is 6 octets GAP_BD_ADDR_LEN. Default value is all zero.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_CHANNEL_MAP

The advertising channel indices that shall be used when transmitting advertising packets. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Value is Advertising Channel Map. Default value is GAP_ADVCHAN_ALL.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_FILTER_POLICY

Filter Policy. Ignored when directed advertising is used. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_GAP_ADV_FILTER_POLICY. Default value is GAP_ADV_FILTER_ANY.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_INTERVAL_MIN

Minimum advertising interval for undirected and low duty cycle directed advertising. Read/Write. Size is 2 octets. Value range: 0x0020 - 0x4000 (20ms - 10240ms 0.625ms/step).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_ADV_INTERVAL_MAX

Maximum advertising interval for undirected and low duty cycle directed advertising. Read/Write. Size is 2 octets. Value range: 0x0020 - 0x4000 (20ms - 10240ms 0.625ms/step).
